hotel.eventDescription: One Booking.com property priced for your dates and guests: its lowest stay price, flags, rating and location (row keys hotel_id, name, url, stars, review_score, review_count, address, latitude, longitude, distance_from_center, price_total, price_nightly, currency, taxes_fees_excluded, free_cancellation, no_prepayment, breakfast_included, room_name): $4 per 1,000 hotels. Not charged: sold-out or unpriced properties (delivered free with Booking's alternative dates), properties maxPrice or minStars remove, a property reached twice in one run, destinations or names that match nothing, status rows, bad input. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price. The run stops at the maximum cost per run you set when starting it (Apify run option maxTotalChargeUsd), never above it.

room.eventDescription: One room and rate combination Booking.com matched to your stay, only when includeRooms is true: room name, occupancy, meal plan, stay total and nightly rate, hotel-currency price, free-cancellation deadline, "only X left" message (row keys hotel_id, hotel_name, room_id, room_name, occupancy, meal_plan, price_total, price_nightly, currency, price_original, original_currency, free_cancellation, free_cancellation_until, only_x_left, check_in, check_out): $2 per 1,000 rows. Not charged when includeRooms is false (default), and never for sold-out properties. The hotel row's rooms_listed is the number of room rows that property adds. No start fee; proxy and compute are included in the event price.
